budget.note: Research BLOCKED; no B sender. Real model sends 0; ledger keeps 0/24, 0 tokens, unknown price. Full costOf→settle chain preserves unknown and blocks; E only reserves.

stages.title: Pilot admission and fail-closed ledger
notes: Complete cost chain: partial usage makes costOf undefined; settle charges the bound, keeps unknown and refuses further sends. Only a B-owned sender module is imported (reservation identity echoed); E never spawns a descriptor command. 66 checks, refusal sends 0.

stages.title: Eight-case three-arm bounded pilot
notes: Real execute chain is implemented but BLOCKED on adapter_missing; B-owned entry, no CLI fallback, no sample replacement.

cases.reason: The legacy record_decision command returned rejected (unsupported_capability); explicit decisions use /v1/decisions (E3-DECISION-WORKFLOW), but structured proposal confirmation remains absent.
No route-advice producer or HTTP entry exists; the schema fixture and gate validators are prepared, and the default path remains closed.
Project settings GET returned 422 and POST returned 422 (unsupported_capability).

stages.title: Current context use, SSE, audit and reply consumer
notes: Real A18 SQLite/result rows plus current HTTP/SSE/UI: selected context, audit, lost response, mobile and two tabs. Independent-process SIGKILL cases cover after-result, during-provider, after-message and corrupted artifact with zero second provider calls.

cases.reason: Explicit decisions now work over HTTP (E3-DECISION-WORKFLOW); automatic context/proposal confirmation is still absent.
No public entry creates a review Work/Ticket/Assignment or publishes ReviewEvidence; the independent pilot preflight is BLOCKED on pricing.
No public entry creates a question with a real decisionDeadline/expiresAt in this checkout; waiting-age and unknown-wait ordering are verified instead.
No public entry deletes/changes the source message or expires the project grant; transaction-failure injection is not exposed. These remain NOT_TESTED.

NOT_TESTED: context preview now exists, but automatic proposal confirmation and grant/revocation invalidation do not. Required inputs: proposal id/revision, source message and digest, current grant/scope/profile/contract, decision to confirm, plus context preview with project/conversation/work binding, window and invalidity. Planned negatives: unconfirmed means no execution; a failed original command leaves no half-confirmed state; an unknown response reuses the same command id; source/actor/grant/scope/profile/version drift is refused; revoke invalidates later context; cross-project isolation and reopen.

NOT_TESTED: E3-CONTEXT-PREVIEW verifies clamped budgets, omissions and basic refusals, but no public entry binds an expired grant or purpose mismatch to the read path. Required: expired grant, purpose mismatch, caller budget above the grant and negative/NaN budget must be refused before any provider read, with the effective window and truncation reported. The C composer probe shows these still fail at the library boundary, so a product pass cannot be claimed.

stages.title: Explicit baseline/target installation and upgrade
notes: Install matrix binds D wave11-target a22d3a4/schema16 with context-use: cold personal, backup/restore, tamper, requested-data-root stop, schema16→current A schema18 migration. Same-schema binary upgrade/rollback is NOT_TESTED because no second schema16 build exists; cross-schema refusal passes. Copied record in another config root still stops the original API on these bytes.

cases.reason: Distribution source paths absent from this checkout: launcher, distribution, portability. A frozen tar.gz is published outside Git and independently accepted by E4-INSTALL-*; source-level installation and migration remain Agent D owned and are not claimed by this case.

Read-only inspect/prepare are verified (plan authorization=not_granted, commitAvailable=false, no writes, stale/foreign/commit refused). The commit path, expiry/drift/replay/rollback of a real grant, and activation of only new work are not implemented and stay NOT_TESTED.

NOT_TESTED: current main product path uses ProductExecution with fixture/Codex profiles, but B's new production control candidate is not consumed by main and native execution is outside this wave. Required: actual product begin command -> Work/Ticket/effect/fact_receipts/dispatch_receipts/answers/answer_deliveries/user_questions/runtime rows, real transport/epoch counts, independent process SIGKILL, unknown no resend, and stop/answer through the existing queue. A fixture or receipt-only row is not production recovery.

stages.title: Bounded context concurrency, recovery windows and stability
notes: E9-CONTEXT-CONCURRENCY plus 50 bounded operations; copy-record ownership uses only this process's spawned API. Generic global cleanup/recover/shared-cache ownership remains out of scope until D fixes and ships bytes.

cases.reason: No executed native stop/question/recovery evidence is available in this checkout.

NOT_TESTED: main has published RecoveryTargetConfiguration/preparation/material/inventory schemas and a configuration binder, but no commit/activate HTTP or composed target startup. Required inputs: source-committed activation fact, A read-only inventory, D materializer readback, main activation pointer switch, and crash replay semantics. Planned negatives: interruption before source commit, after source commit but before target preparation, during target preparation, and at pointer switch must never dispatch old queues, never grant authority from an old ended/PID/missing writer, and never duplicate authorization on response loss or restart; a backup/re-restore must not inherit executable authority. A schema or read-only prepare is not activation.

NOT_TESTED: wave14 actual self-owned checks cover requested data root, copied record and wrong install; D's new identity UID/argv/operation, foreign journal scope, per-PID scan failure, malformed inventory and old/new install-role mocks were not independently reproduced in this checkout. Required: import the current D ownership functions with injected inventory/signals and assert UNKNOWN/refusal for each, before any broad live cleanup matrix.

stages.title: Layered conclusions and handoff
notes: wave12-status separates test source, main 530085c/schema18, D a22d3a4/schema16 artifact and current-main install NOT_TESTED; wave11 and older status files are frozen.

stages.title: Two-state stop and real process faults
notes: E4-MULTI-STATE on D cf7a3cf bytes still claims state B and kills its API for a stop aimed at state A; launcher-dead/API-alive remains NOT_TESTED because that defect destroys the prerequisite. E4-INSTALL-HOST-GUARDS covers unknown PID refusal.

stages.title: Backup, schema migration and managed upgrade
notes: E8-SCHEMA-MIGRATION takes a real schema15 DB from the frozen D install and opens it with current A: schema16, data count preserved, binding table present, reopen stable. Backup/restore, managed upgrade/rollback and cross-schema refusal run on the same tuple; PA_UPGRADE_FAULT crash windows remain NOT_TESTED.

stages.title: Bounded concurrency and stability
notes: E9-CONTEXT-CONCURRENCY: four distinct selected sends + duplicate replay, one provider call per command and four bindings. Existing 30-cycle bounded stability remains; FD/child/queue baselines are observed, not a leak proof.

stages.title: Source-driven final report
notes: wave11-status separates test source, main source, product/artifact tuple and current-main install NOT_TESTED; old wave10/09 status files are frozen and not rewritten.
Controlled fixture, SDK mock, readonly and installed evidence never substitute for actual-native execution.
A NOT_TESTED or BLOCKED gap is honest only when the release claim excludes that capability; there is no allow-gap switch.
